subject.character: ONE spotted hyena, shaggy fur, no clothing, a crumpled napkin on her elbow, upright on hind legs, two thirds of frame height, same look all ten seconds
subject.physicality: claws rake the tin, the tail keeps digging in the bin, the jaw clacks on the bottle neck
subject.anti_action: she plays a sommelier over a garbage bin: sniffs an empty bottle neck with lidded eyes, rolls air in her mouth, verdict with a stone face, napkin on the elbow, even restaurant stride

side_characters.hat_jackal: ONE jackal in a crumpled party hat from yesterday, pushes the bin cart, he drained the last bottle
side_characters.crate_jackal: ONE jackal with a crate of empty glass
side_characters.rule: both stay a step from the lens, moving across frame

props.bottles: empty costly liquor bottles, thick heavy base, long neck, foil collar, wax seal
props.bin: tin bin on a low rolling cart

prop_continuity: every bottle empty, not one drop; the bin full at the start, empty at the end
environment: banquet hall back yard, overflowing bins, a curb, heaps of glass, passage packed with movement
motion_rule: every beat moves across frame OR at the lens; hyena head over a third of frame, new shot size each beat; camera pans with her, the yard tearing past; horizontal only, no vertical moves

audio.delivery: weary, flat, native Russian, no accent, 4.0 syllables per second
audio.pacing: first word at 0.00, no words after 6.1, the tail 6.1-10.0 carries sfx only, her mouth busy with the bottle
audio.pronunciation: ot-KLA-dy-val, LUCH-she-ye, KA-zhet-sya, za-KON-chi-los, vche-RA; latin hints are never spoken

timeline.a: she rips her muzzle out of the bin and slings a bottle with a base the size of her head at the lens
she strides across frame beside the rolling bin, the napkin on her elbow flapping
she pulls the next neck from the rolling bin past her nostrils and dives at the camera, open jaw filling the frame
she hurls the dry bottle behind her back, her tail flinging a wad of foil out of the bin at the lens
she strides at the lens, jaw working, muzzle over half the frame, the crate jackal spilling a bottle at the camera behind her shoulder
she strides on as the hat jackal turns the last bottle neck down at the lens, wax seal across the frame, not a drop, then drops it into her bin
she scoops that bottle out of the rolling bin without breaking stride, claws screeching down the tin
punchline: she dives at the camera, muzzle filling the frame, tongue deep in the bottle neck licking it out from inside, eyes shut in bliss
the hat jackal claps a second empty into her paw as he passes, her eyes still shut
the cart slams the curb and a wave of empty bottles rolls at the lens, flashing the noon sun
she strides on across frame, the second empty swinging in her paw

must_appear: napkin on her elbow in every beat
hat jackal tips a bottle neck down at the lens at 4.1
every line spoken, last word by 6.1
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, text overlay, digits, a label, printed words, garbled words, Latin letters, English speech, foreign accent, drawn-out delivery, slow motion, a static camera, a still background, an empty yard, standing in place, gloom, duplicate props, floating objects, a closed jaw while speaking, extra limbs, multiple hyenas, clothing on the hyena, a word not in the lines
